title: Talking with AI: an interlocutor, not a curator

outline.heading: Start with the most inconvenient fact

points.text: The evidence says that what works in digital programmes is a human in the loop.
The largest online randomised trial in this area — Segal and colleagues (JAMA Psychiatry, 2020; 460 participants) — showed an advantage of an online programme over usual care.
The detail usually lost in retellings: the programme ran with coach support, not as a purely self-guided app.
Hence the course's honest position: AI sits here between sessions, not instead of people.
The boundaries aren't invented by the course — they're assembled from normative documents and from the few places where an effect has actually been shown

outline.heading: What the companion may not do — and why

points.text: The American Psychological Association Health Advisory on generative AI chatbots and wellness applications (November 2025) is the weightiest normative source available today.
That is a vendor statement rather than research — an admission against interest — and it bears directly on our construction: an eight-week course with a companion is precisely a long interaction.

points: The evidence says that digital programmes work best when there is a human in the loop.
A trial by Segal and colleagues in JAMA Psychiatry in 2020 with 460 participants showed an advantage over usual care.
This programme used coach support rather than being a purely self-guided app.
The course takes the position that AI sits between sessions rather than instead of people.
The boundaries for the companion are based on normative documents and proven effects instead of being invented by the course.
The American Psychological Association Health Advisory on generative AI chatbots and wellness applications from November 2025 is the weightiest normative source available today.
This vendor statement acts as an admission that an eight-week course with a companion is a long interaction.
The Illinois WOPR Act for Wellness and Oversight for Psychological Resources was signed as PA 104-0054 on 1 August 2025.
Nevada and Utah passed similar restrictions in 2025.
One more thing worth saying plainly is that it does not read your state.
In the US you can call the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline or the local crisis line in another country.
Checked numbers for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Germany are in step five.
Other countries are in the international directory findahelpline.com.
